rationale: A combines category ratio, linear solve, pure-latent sum, corpus inspection of top latents, true logits on a pronoun-only edited paragraph, and joint property ablation. B applies only a single ratio of the top property-latent contribution to the true topic-swap effect. B shares only the ratio skeleton.

Both use a category-contribution versus true-gap ratio for none. A adds an all-properties flip counterfactual at fixed topic, measured with true logits, and inspects the gradient-sum table for a dominant category. B relies only on the max property-latent contribution over the topic-swap effect.
